11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined the process for appealing an increased tax rate, including:
    - Grievance Day: Typically the fourth Tuesday in May.
    - Review the assessment roll.
    - File a complaint (RP-524).
    - Gather supporting documentation.
    - Assessment Review Board (ARB) process.
    - Small Claims Assessment Review (SCAR) if unsatisfied with ARB decision.
